svg.text: Blank 140 x 530 mm. Front view is the face the box sits on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights up from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots 3 x 15 at 51 each side, centred 20 and 510 up:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chain drill 3 mm and file square. The bands go through these.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V-block screws 4.5, countersunk from the front, at 18 each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug screws 5.5 at 44 each side, 302 and 478 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saddle screws 5.5 at 17.4 each side, 100 and 230 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Barometric housing 4.5 at 45 to the left (seen from the front),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole and edge; round the corners about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the V-blocks, lugs and saddles on it and look through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each hole; the holes must line up without forcing a screw.
